description: Activate when: user says 'is our data a moat?', 'how do we build up proprietary data?', 'how do we set up a data flywheel?', 'investors keep asking about our data defensibility', 'data network effects', or must decide whether to invest in collecting, labeling, or partnering for data. Do NOT activate when: the data only feeds internal reporting with no product use; the question is pure data engineering or storage selection; the question is about moat types in general (use economic-moat) or user-to-user network effects (use network-effects). More: deciqai.com/c/proprietary-data-moat
